result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout/content overlap problem and one minor truncation issue.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows overlapping text: '25-35 min delivery' and '€0 delivery' text appear to be rendered on top of each other in the subtitle area, reading '25-3€0 delivery' which is visually broken and confusing.
issues.suggestion: Separate the delivery time and delivery cost into distinct UI elements (e.g., two separate labels or a properly formatted string like '25-35 min · €0 delivery') to avoid text overlap.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated without an ellipsis, cutting off the full name abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis or increase the card width to accommodate longer restaurant names, ensuring truncation is graceful and visually consistent.
